([[FC Anyang|Anyang]]) |- | align=center|Forwards | colspan="2"|{{flagicon|CRC}} [[Jonathan Moya]] ([[FC Anyang|Anyang]]) | colspan="2"|{{flagicon|PRK}} [[An Byong-jun]] ([[Busan IPark|Busan]]) |} == Controversies == On 12 December 2021, [[Gangwon FC]] and [[Daejeon Hana Citizen]] faced one another in the second leg of the Promotion-relegation play-offs, with the latter team finding himself in advantage after winning the first leg 1–0. Played at [[Gangneung Stadium]], Gangwon's home soil, the match saw the hosts secure a 4–1 comeback victory and maintain their spot in K League 1. However, the game was marred by a series of [[Football hooliganism|incidents]], occurring between the first and the second half. After [[Han Kook-young]] had scored Gangwon's third goal in the 31st minute, the [[ball boy]]s around the stadium reportedly started to delay giving the ball back to Daejeon players, an event that happened multiple times during the match and was possibly meant to waste time in favour of the hosts: the fans in the away sector reacted furiously, with some of them throwing [[plastic bottle]]s in direction of one of the ball boys. The game still went ahead, as six minutes of extra time were added at the end of the second half. The [[K League]] administration decided to open an official investigation on the controversial events.{{Cite web|last=Neat|first=Paul|date=2021-12-21|title=Gangwon FC fined for Playoff Final "ballboy controversy"|url=https://www.kleagueunited.com/2021/12/gangwon-fc-fined-for-playoff-final.html|url-status=live|access-date=2021-12-21|website=K League United|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211221101533/https://www.kleagueunited.com/2021/12/gangwon-fc-fined-for-playoff-final.html |archive-date=2021-12-21 }}{{Cite web |last=Lee |first=Seok-moo |date=2021-12-21 |script-title=ko:'볼보이 고의 지연 논란' 강원FC, 제재금 3천만원..."구단 책임 커" |url=https://sports.news.naver.com/news?oid=018&aid=0005111190 |url-status=live |access-date=2021-12-21 |website=[[Naver]] |language=ko |publisher=Edaily |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211221164419/https://sports.news.naver.com/news?oid=018&aid=0005111190 |archive-date=2021-12-21 }} When asked to talk about the incidents, Gangwon's director [[Lee Young-pyo]] originally dismissed them, pointing out that similar instances were already common in [[Football in Europe|European football]], but later apologized, saying that he felt "direct responsibility" for the "unsmooth match" and promising that he would work so that Gangwon FC would become "a mature club" in the future. Meanwhile, on 21 December, just hours before K League's final disciplinary meeting took place, the Daejeon board released an official response to the matter, stating that there was "clear evidence of the game delays being intentional and organized", as well as noticing that such acts violated the league's [[Ethical code|Code of Ethics]] for fair play and respect.{{Cite web |last=Kim |first=Myeong-seok |date=2021-12-21 |script-title=ko:"강원 볼보이 논란, 누군가 지시 없이는 불가능" 대전, 철저한 진상조사 요구 |url=https://sports.news.naver.com/news?oid=108&aid=0003014499 |url-status=live |access-date=2021-12-21 |website=[[Naver]] |language=ko |publisher=Starnews Korea |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211221164420/https://sports.news.naver.com/news?oid=108&aid=0003014499 |archive-date=2021-12-21 }} In the end, the league's administration decided to keep the final score unchanged: however, Gangwon FC was fined 30 million [[South Korean won|South Korean Won]] (US$25,000) for the episodes of time wasting, whereas Daejeon Hana Citizen was fined 2 million South Korean Won (US$1,677) for their fans' behavior towards one of the ball boys. == See also == * [[2021 in South Korean football]] * [[2021 Korean FA Cup]] ==References== {{Reflist|2}} ==External links== * [https://web.archive.org/web/20141006152043/http://www.kleague.com/eng/ Official website] {{K League seasons}} {{2021 in South Korean football}} [[Category:K League 2 seasons]] [[Category:2021 in South Korean football|2]] [[Category:2021 in Asian second-tier association football leagues|K]]
